title: Drinking Water — Specification
scope: Specifies the quality requirements of drinking water intended for human consumption, including physical, chemical, bacteriological, and biological requirements. Permissible limits: Total Dissolved Solids ≤500 mg/l (desirable) / ≤2000 mg/l (permissible), pH 6.5–8.5, Turbidity ≤1 NTU (desirable), Fluoride ≤1.0 mg/l, Nitrate ≤45 mg/l, Arsenic ≤0.01 mg/l, Lead ≤0.01 mg/l, E.coli: absent in 100 ml.
qco_ref: Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act — IS 10500 referenced by BIS for packaged water

title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
scope: Specifies quality requirements for packaged drinking water. Water must meet IS 10500 limits before packaging. Additional requirements: total plate count <100 CFU/ml at 37°C, coliforms absent in 100 ml, yeast and mould absent, package must be tamper-evident. ISI Mark mandatory on label.
qco_ref: Packaged Drinking Water (Quality Control) Order, 2000 (GSR 696(E))
test_labs: BIS Western Regional Testing Centre Mumbai

title: Packaged Natural Mineral Water — Specification
scope: Specifies standards for natural mineral water from underground sources with characteristic mineral composition. Must be microbiologically wholesome at source; no treatment permitted except CO2 removal/addition, ozonation, UV treatment. Radon ≤100 Bq/l, total coliforms absent in 250 ml. Must state mineral composition on label.
qco_ref: Packaged Natural Mineral Water (Quality Control) Order, 2019

title: Stainless Steel Vacuum Insulated Containers — Specification
scope: Covers vacuum-insulated containers including water bottles, flasks, tumblers, mugs, and food containers made from stainless steel. Material: food-grade stainless steel (minimum Grade 304/18-8). Requirements: vacuum insulation retention test (24-hour temperature retention ≥6 hours for hot, ≥24 hours for cold), leak test, drop test from 1.5m, food contact migration limits per IS 9845, and marking requirements including material grade and capacity.
qco_ref: Not currently under a QCO. Voluntary certification under Scheme I available.

title: Stainless Steel Utensils — Specification
scope: Requirements for stainless steel utensils for domestic use. Material: stainless steel conforming to IS 6603 (food grade grades 304/316). Surface finish: No. 4 (brushed) or mirror finish; free from pits, laps, scratches. Rivets and handles: must be food-safe. Migration limits: chromium ≤0.1 mg/dm², nickel ≤0.02 mg/dm² (per IS 9845 migration test using 3% acetic acid at 70°C for 2 hours).
qco_ref: Not currently mandated. Voluntary ISI certification recommended.

title: Safety of Toys — Part 1: Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties
scope: Safety requirements for mechanical and physical properties of toys for children under 14 years. Key requirements: no small parts detachable by normal force for children under 36 months (cylinder test: diameter < 31.7mm, depth < 57mm), no sharp points/edges accessible after abuse test, minimum cord diameter 1.5mm, no projectile tips > 45 J/m2 kinetic energy, no folding mechanism that can trap fingers. Conforms to IEC 62115 (electrical aspects). Manufacturer must conduct ASTM F963 / EN 71-1 equivalent tests.
qco_ref: Toys (Quality Control) Order, 2020 (GSR 281(E) dated 21 May 2020)
test_labs: BIS Northern Regional Testing Centre Chandigarh

title: Safety of Toys — Part 2: Flammability
scope: Flammability requirements for toys. Prohibited materials: celluloid (except for printing/coating). Fabric: burning rate must not exceed 30 mm/s for pile fabric, 10 mm/s for non-pile fabric when tested by prescribed method. Foam: burning rate ≤ 30 mm/s. Disguise costumes: must be tested per EN 71-2 equivalent method.
qco_ref: Toys (Quality Control) Order, 2020 (GSR 281(E))
test_labs: BIS Northern Regional Testing Centre Chandigarh

title: Safety of Toys — Part 3: Migration of Certain Elements
scope: Chemical safety requirements for toys — limits on migration of hazardous elements from toy materials. Antimony: 60 mg/kg, Arsenic: 25 mg/kg, Barium: 1000 mg/kg, Cadmium: 75 mg/kg, Chromium: 60 mg/kg, Lead: 90 mg/kg, Mercury: 60 mg/kg, Selenium: 500 mg/kg. Test method: extraction with 0.07 M HCl at 37°C for 1 hour.
qco_ref: Toys (Quality Control) Order, 2020 (GSR 281(E))

title: Information Technology Equipment — Safety — Part 1: General Requirements
scope: Safety requirements for ITE including computers, laptops, printers, scanners, monitors, servers, and networking equipment. Equivalent to IEC 60950-1:2005 + AMD1:2009 + AMD2:2013. Key requirements: electrical safety (creepage/clearance distances per pollution degree and working voltage), insulation (double/reinforced insulation for accessible parts), temperature limits, fire enclosure, TNV (Telecommunication Network Voltage) circuit protection.
qco_ref: Electronics and IT Goods (Requirement for Compulsory Registration) Order, 2012 (CRS Order)
test_labs: BIS Southern Regional Testing Centre Chennai
BIS South Western Regional Testing Centre Bengaluru

title: Audio/Video and Similar Electronic Apparatus — Safety — Part 1: General Requirements
scope: Safety requirements for audio, video, and electronic entertainment apparatus for household and similar general use. Equivalent to IEC 60065:2014. Covers mains-powered, battery-operated, and cathode-ray-tube/LCD television sets, amplifiers, DVD players, and set-top boxes. Key safety: SELV circuit requirements, insulation, mains isolation, loudspeaker impedance.
qco_ref: Electronics and IT Goods (Requirement for Compulsory Registration) Order, 2012 (CRS Order)
test_labs: BIS Southern Regional Testing Centre Chennai

title: Specification for Self-Ballasted Lamps for General Lighting Services — Safety Requirements (LED Lamps)
scope: Safety requirements for LED lamps with integrated ballast (self-ballasted), designed to replace incandescent lamps. Supply voltage up to 250V AC. Requirements: cap and lampholders conformity (E27/B22 base per IS 4109/IS 16103), temperature limit (T case ≤105°C for electrolytic capacitors), IP rating, UV radiation limit, lamp life claim substantiation, and correct marking of wattage, voltage, luminous flux.
qco_ref: Electronics and IT Goods (Requirement for Compulsory Registration) Order, 2012 — LED Lamps listed in Schedule I
test_labs: BIS Southern Regional Testing Centre Chennai
BIS South Western Regional Testing Centre Bengaluru

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement — Specification
scope: Requirements for hot-rolled and cold-twisted deformed (TMT — Thermo-Mechanically Treated) steel bars used as reinforcement in concrete. Grades: Fe 415, Fe 415D, Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 550, Fe 550D, Fe 600. Key properties: Yield Strength/0.2% Proof Stress (Fe 500: min 500 MPa), UTS/YS ratio ≥ 1.08, elongation ≥ 12% (Fe 500), bend and rebend test requirements, chemical composition limits (C, S, P, Mn, S+P combined).
qco_ref: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2012 — TMT Bars mandatory ISI Mark
test_labs: BIS Eastern Regional Testing Centre Kolkata

title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel — Specification
scope: Requirements for hot rolled medium and high tensile structural steel (plates, strips, shapes, sections, flats, bars) for use in bridges, buildings, cranes, towers, wagons, shipbuilding, and other general structural purposes. Grades: E 250 (A/B/C/BR/B0/C0), E 300, E 350, E 410, E 450, E 550, E 650. Tensile strength and elongation tests; charpy impact tests for sub-grades.
qco_ref: Not currently mandated under a QCO. ISI Mark voluntary.
test_labs: BIS Eastern Regional Testing Centre Kolkata

title: Ordinary Portland Cement, 43 Grade — Specification
scope: Requirements for Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC) 43 Grade. Chemical requirements: CaO ≥ 62%, SiO2 ≥ 20%, Fe2O3 ≤ 6.5%, MgO ≤ 6%, SO3 ≤ 3.5%, Loss on Ignition ≤ 5%, Lime Saturation Factor 0.80–1.02. Physical requirements: Fineness (Blaine) ≥ 225 m²/kg, Initial setting time ≥ 30 min, Final setting time ≤ 600 min, Soundness (Le Chatelier) ≤ 10mm. Strength (IS 4031 method): 3-day ≥ 23 MPa, 7-day ≥ 33 MPa, 28-day ≥ 43 MPa.
qco_ref: Cement (Quality Control) Order, 2003

title: Portland Pozzolana Cement — Specification — Part 1: Fly Ash Based
scope: Requirements for PPC made by inter-grinding Portland cement clinker with fly ash (15–35% fly ash by mass). 28-day compressive strength ≥ 33 MPa. Used in mass concrete, marine structures, underground works. MgO ≤ 6%, SO3 ≤ 3.0%, LOI (fly ash fraction) ≤ 5%.
qco_ref: Cement (Quality Control) Order, 2003

title: Unplasticized PVC Pipes for Potable Water Supplies — Specification
scope: Requirements for UPVC pipes for potable water. Pipe series: Class 1 (0.25 MPa) through Class 5 (1.25 MPa). Material: PVC compound per IS 7328. Key tests: hydraulic pressure test (2× working pressure for 1 hour), ring stiffness, vicat softening point ≥ 80°C, impact strength (drop weight at 0°C), reversion test (not more than 5% change at 150°C). Migration: extractable matter ≤ 2 mg/dm².
qco_ref: Plastic Pipes and Fittings (Quality Control) Order, 2021
test_labs: BIS Western Regional Testing Centre Mumbai

title: PVC Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and including 1100 V — Specification
scope: Requirements for PVC insulated cables for fixed wiring of buildings up to 1100V. Conductor: plain annealed copper (Class 1 or 2 per IS 8130). Insulation: PVC compound (Type A or B). Tests: conductor resistance (max per cross-section at 20°C), insulation resistance (min 10 MΩ·km at 70°C), high voltage test (2000V AC for 5 min), oxygen index ≥ 29%, smoke density test, flame retardance per IS 10810.
qco_ref: Conductors and Cables (Quality Control) Order, 2020
test_labs: BIS Southern Regional Testing Centre Chennai

title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets for Domestic and Similar General Purposes — Specification
scope: Requirements for AC plugs and socket-outlets rated up to 250V, 16A for domestic use. Two configurations: 6A (round pins, 3.96mm dia) and 16A (round pins, 4.78mm dia), 3-pin with earthing. Earth connection must be made before live conductors. Tests: current-carrying capacity, temperature rise (≤45°C above ambient at rated current), making and breaking capacity, strength of fixing screws, resistance to heat.
qco_ref: Wiring Devices (Quality Control) Order, 2019
test_labs: BIS Southern Regional Testing Centre Chennai

title: Gold and Gold Alloys — Fineness, Assay and Marking — Specification
scope: Specifies fineness designations for gold and gold alloys used in jewellery. Recognised fineness grades: 999 (24K), 958 (23K), 916 (22K), 875 (21K), 750 (18K), 585 (14K). Assay methods: cupellation (fire assay) per IS 4956, AAS, or XRF. Hallmark stamp must include: BIS Logo, Fineness (e.g. 916), AHC identification mark, HUID (6-digit alphanumeric code from BIS HUID portal).
qco_ref: Gold (Compulsory Hallmarking) Order, 2021 — mandatory in all 256+ notified districts
cert_scheme: BIS Hallmarking Scheme (Jeweller Licence + Assaying at A&H Centre)
test_labs: BIS-recognised Assaying and Hallmarking (A&H) Centres across India

title: Crystalline Silicon Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules — Design Qualification and Type Approval
scope: Qualification testing requirements for crystalline silicon PV modules. Equivalent to IEC 61215. Test sequence includes: visual inspection, maximum power determination, insulation resistance (>400 MΩ·m² at 1000V), thermal cycling (200 cycles at ±40°C), humidity-freeze test (−40°C to +85°C, 85% RH), damp heat (85°C/85% RH for 1000 hours), UV preconditioning, mechanical load test (2400 Pa), hail test (25mm ice ball at 23 m/s), bypass diode thermal test.
qco_ref: Solar Photovoltaic Systems, Devices and Components (Quality Control) Order, 2017
test_labs: BIS South Western Regional Testing Centre Bengaluru

title: Helmets for Motor Cycle Riders — Specification
scope: Requirements for protective helmets for motorcycle riders (full-face, open-face, modular, off-road types). Shell material: fibreglass, thermoplastic, or carbon fibre. Tests: energy absorption (impact attenuation ≤400g peak acceleration), penetration test (3kg cone dropped from 3m), chin strap retention (no slippage > 25mm under 30 kg force), field of vision (≥105° total horizontal, ≥7° vertical upward, ≥45° vertical downward from horizontal midpoint), reflector requirements.
qco_ref: Protective Helmets for Two-Wheeler Riders (Quality Control) Order, 2020 (GSR 1(E))
test_labs: BIS Northern Regional Testing Centre Chandigarh
